verdict.rationale: The docs show LobeHub can use several model backends. There are self-hosting guides for Azure OpenAI and Ollama, the changelog adds Gemini 3.6 Flash and Kimi K3 to the model list, and pricing offers GLM and GPT models. Missing for 10: any evidence of Anthropic or OpenRouter as providers, documentation of switching models per agent or per conversation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-provider use.
